use_when: To take the user to another page or view, such as "Show all 24 amenities" or "Forgot your password?".
For a secondary action next to a form, such as "Resend code" or "Use a different email address".
To edit or manage an item in a list, such as "Edit" or "Manage" in account settings.
Use size md (13px) next to body text and on its own, and size sm (12px) in dense rows, such as "Clear" beside filters.

dont_use_when.when: For the main action on a page, such as submitting a form or booking: use the Button component instead.
To filter results or switch categories: use the Chip component instead.
To open a list of options to choose from: use the Dropdown component instead.

a11y.fact: The control is a native <a>, so keyboard focus, the focus ring, activation and :visited behaviour are the browser's own; no focus style is overridden.
href, target, rel and every other anchor attribute pass through because the passthrough props are spread onto the element.
The label is the anchor's text content, which gives it its accessible name.
